title: Eventual full-B2 bound with refined entropy and shorter prefix: 51460722621771815621/10097617584151289100

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. experiments.purpose: Terminal decodes the outward-coarsened 20-sweep prefix, performs 32 suffix sweeps and certifies physical depth 15679, a strict terminal minority and all 1625 exact entropy comparisons. Request one follow-up with {"phase":"energy"} to freshly regenerate all 20 prefix sweeps, compare every decoded state and digest, and compute the graph energy and initial majority. The phases check 9648 and 6030 main-row updates.
